review:
Gravity Bonanza sets a cluster-pays game in deep space. Asteroids, stars and moons fill a 7x7 grid, and five or more matching symbols touching each other form a win that cascades away. The standout symbol is the black hole, which pulls in every instance of a random symbol and pays it as a cluster at the end of the round, creating more tumbles as those symbols disappear.

Three or more scatters start free spins, with extra scatters adding spins up to a total of 50. In the bonus, black holes can arrive with multipliers up to 10x, applied to the symbol they collect. The game advertises a 10,000x maximum. The 96.09% RTP is slightly below the studio's usual 96.5% version. The black hole mechanic makes it feel genuinely different from Pragmatic's other cluster games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
